name: Nineveh under Jonah
charge: Wickedness come up before the Lord
summary: Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown. The people believed God, proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth from the greatest to the least; the king rose from his throne, sat in ashes, and decreed that man and beast cry mightily unto God and turn from the violence in their hands.
offense: The charge is given in one line, their wickedness is come up before me, and Nahum a century later spells out what Assyria's wickedness was: a bloody city, full of lies and robbery, whose prey departeth not.
judgment: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way, and repented of the evil that he had said he would do unto them. Jeremiah states the rule: if that nation turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil I thought to do. Christ: the men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation and condemn it.
